name: shard-api
description: Scripts npm pour piloter l'API Python

scripts.init: python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install --upgrade -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: . .venv/bin/activate && export API_ENV=development && python -m uvicorn api.main:app --reload --host $(python -c "from api.core import utils; print(utils.API_IP)") --port $(python -c "from api.core import utils; print(utils.API_PORT)")
scripts.verbose: . .venv/bin/activate && export API_ENV=development && python -m uvicorn api.main:app --reload --host $(python -c "from api.core import utils; print(utils.API_IP)") --port $(python -c "from api.core import utils; print(utils.API_PORT)") --log-level debug
scripts.pm2:start: pm2 start npm --name shard-api -- run start
